premises.text: No product on the market can tell people what places and events go together for their occasion
premises.evidence_span: there's not a single product on the market today that can tell you what places and what events go together for your occasion

premises.text: People plan by mood and companions, and they want review snippets of what is new and fresh nearby
premises.evidence_span: they wanted review snippets of what's new and fresh and happening in the area

premises.text: The engine searches thousands of places and events across the web in real time, algorithmically classifying, ranking, and composing itineraries on the fly
premises.evidence_span: goes out across the web, looking at thousands of places and events, algorithmically classifying them, ranking them, and on the fly, composing them into itineraries to fit my needs

premises.text: Generated plans are never hand curated or canned, and they carry reviews and booking links for immediate decisions
premises.evidence_span: Everything's algorithmically generated. Not a single thing is hand curated

premises.text: The plan belongs to the user, who can customize it however they want
premises.evidence_span: I can do whatever I want with it. I can customize this however I want

premises.text: Friends can advise on the plan through Facebook and add places to it in real time
premises.evidence_span: They all get a Facebook notification saying I've asked them for some advice on my WeOtta plan

premises.text: The plan becomes a Facebook event in less than two seconds, easier than on Facebook itself
premises.evidence_span: There's our Facebook event. That happened in less than two seconds

value.text: People get their evening made for them — what to do tonight with all the hassle removed
value.evidence_span: It made our evening for us

secondary_value.text: As coverage and personalization grow, the right inventory reaches the right people at the right time
secondary_value.evidence_span: Ouyada will have the right inventory to the right people at the right time

causal_links.evidence_span: It solves the problem of what to do tonight. It also takes all the hassle out of planning it

notes: Audience interjections during the demo excluded per 4.2; the founder's answers remain codable and support P4. The planning-behavior findings (mood/companions, review snippets, event-first itineraries, Facebook personalization) are compressed into P2 as one user-research premise about how people plan — splitting each interview finding would over-split restatements of the same behavioral assumption.
